rationale: Coprococcus comes ferments abundant lactate and glucose anaerobically. Lactate (12 mmol/gDW/h) and glucose (8 mmol/gDW/h) provide 84 mmol C/h. With 30 mmol C/g biomass cost and 8 mmol N/g, ammonium uptake of 6 mmol/h supports 0.7 /h growth. Remaining carbon (54 mmol/h) is fermented to butyrate (8.5) and acetate (8.5) as primary products, with CO₂ release. Carbon balance: 84 in = 21 (biomass) + 34 (butyrate) + 17 (acetate) + 12 (CO₂).
